name: timer
description: A configurable count-up / count-down timer overlay. Publishes lifecycle events to the EventBus so hooks and other plugins can react without hardcoded coupling.
author: TechnikLey

emitted_events.name: Timer Pauses
emitted_events.desc: When the countdown timer is paused

emitted_events.name: Timer Resets
emitted_events.desc: When the countdown timer is reset

emitted_events.name: Timer Ticks
emitted_events.desc: Every second while the timer is running

emitted_events.name: Timer Milestone
emitted_events.desc: When the timer passes a configured milestone

start.name: Start Timer
start.desc: Begin the countdown from the current time

reset.name: Reset Timer
reset.desc: Reset the timer to its starting value

add_time.name: Add Time
add_time.desc: Add seconds to the current timer

set_time.name: Set Time
set_time.desc: Set the timer to a specific number of seconds

fields.label: Direction
fields.help: Count down from start_time or count up from zero

fields.label: Start Time (seconds)
fields.help: Initial time in seconds. For direction=down this is the countdown start; for up this is the maximum (used with loop/stop logic).

fields.label: Time Step (seconds)
fields.help: How many seconds to add/remove per tick

fields.label: Auto Start
fields.help: Start the timer automatically when the plugin loads

fields.label: Loop
fields.help: When counting down and reaching zero, automatically reset to start_time instead of pausing

fields.label: Reset On
fields.help: Events that trigger an automatic reset: zero = timer hits zero; manual = reset command; command = any set_time/add_time command

fields.label: Signal On
fields.help: Timer events published to the EventBus via POST /api/v1/events. Consumers (hooks, other plugins) can subscribe without coupling.

fields.label: Milestones (seconds)
fields.help: List of times (seconds) at which a timer.milestone event is emitted. Count-down triggers at or below; count-up triggers at or above.
